    PLENUABYRU

    Rehearsal studio in Warsaw (Praga)

    Sanctum Sound runs an acoustically treated rehearsal studio in Warsaw’s Praga-Południe district, ready for bands, duos and solo musicians. Turn up with your instruments and play: the backline, drum kit and PA are already in the room, and cables are included free. Room rental starts at 50 PLN per hour.

    Full Backline

    We offer tube guitar and bass amplifiers, a fully equipped drum kit for playing, and high-quality 800 Watt PA equipment. Everything is regularly serviced, ensuring reliability, playing comfort and excellent sound

    Acoustic Treatment

    The room is acoustically prepared to provide clean and balanced sound. It reduces unwanted reflections, improves listening comfort and allows you to focus on the music. Book your session and hear the difference from the very first rehearsal

    Flexible Booking

    We have available slots for hourly rental and regular long-term sessions. If you have any questions, write to us or book directly through the website

    Comfort and support

    Free coffee or tea on site. Support throughout rehearsals or recordings. Toilet and air conditioning. If you need anything, just ask the administrator

    A band rehearsal room with full backline

    Everything a band rehearsal room in Warsaw should have is already set up, so you spend your hour playing instead of hauling gear:

    • Tube guitar amplifiers
    • Bass amplifiers
    • A full drum kit
    • An 800 W PA for vocals
    • Cables included free of charge

    Acoustics and comfort

    The room is acoustically treated to tame harsh reflections, so every player can hear the rest of the band clearly. Air conditioning keeps it comfortable through long sessions, there’s a toilet on site, and coffee and tea are on the house.

    Hourly bookings or a regular weekly slot

    Need a room for an hour before a gig, to try out new material or for a one-off jam? An hourly rehearsal studio in Warsaw is exactly that — book the time you need and nothing more. Bands that rehearse every week can take a regular slot on the same day and time. Musicians who just want to play together use it as a jam room in Warsaw, too.

    Price and booking

    Rehearsal room hire starts at 50 PLN per hour, with the backline, PA and cables included. To book, use the contact form on this site, call +48 881 238 684 or message @sanctum_sound_studio on Instagram, and tell us which day suits you and whether you’re after a one-off session or a regular slot.

    How to get to the rehearsal space

    Our rehearsal space in Warsaw is at Aleja Stanów Zjednoczonych 67, 03-770 Warszawa, in Praga-Południe. Aleja Stanów Zjednoczonych is a main road on the right bank of the Vistula, well served by city buses and trams. You can plan your route on Google Maps or Jakdojade.

    Questions and answers

    What’s included when I book the rehearsal room in Warsaw?

    Tube guitar amps, bass amps, a full drum kit, an 800 W PA and cables, plus air conditioning, a toilet and free coffee or tea.

    Can I book the rehearsal studio for just one hour?

    Yes. The room can be booked by the hour, from 50 PLN per hour.

    Do you offer regular weekly slots?

    Yes. Bands that rehearse regularly can book a fixed weekly slot. Get in touch and we’ll find a day and time that works.

    Do I need to bring my own cables or amps?

    No. The backline, drum kit, PA and cables are already in the room. Just bring your instruments.

    Book a session

    Send us a message through the form or call +48 881 238 684.
